gddGap: The GDD says "urban districts" and "Defeat Wave / Clear Arena ... in time" but sets no level count, order, wave counts or time limit. Level 1 is paced as a tutorial arc (warm-up, pressure, first Breaker, escalation, finale) with health pickups in the breathers; wave numbers and the 210 s limit are design assumptions, not GDD-confirmed.
name: Brick-Red Alley
theme: Zed's home alley: brick walls, a mustard corner shop, mural panels and an open window with music.
intro: Home. The alley where Zed learned to fight, dance and argue like family. Push the Rust back and let the block breathe.
outro: The alley is ours again. A window cracks open and a record starts to play. Zed grins. Next stop, Mustard Row.

waves.hint: Caught in the middle? Step out so they're all in front of you.

notes: Bosses per the-story-campaign#1 (miniBoss/mainBoss are enemy ids, not wave entries). Arena flavour: tutorial alley; no main boss per the-story-campaign#1. Owner decision: the mini-boss arrives as a mini wave, a beatable pressure wave led by the mini-boss, deliberately not too hard and not a hard gate. No boss phase on this level. Owner decision: wave 5 is the mini-boss beat: "Brick" Dugan leads and 4 grunts join in the same wave with mixed entrances (Dugan walks in from the far side first, grunts flank in from both edges). It replaces the old 10-enemy wave 5, so wave 5 is smaller than wave 4 by design (validator exempts leader waves from the no-shrink rule).

miniBoss.note: beatable pressure wave led by the mini-boss: Dugan plus 4 grunts in wave 5

gddGap: No level structure in the GDD. Introduces the Rust Watcher (rust-watcher) as the first new threat, mixed with grunts, Type 2 Breakers from wave 3, and "Railgun" Royce as the wave 5 mini-boss; wave sizes are assumed; the 210 s limit and the 5-wave arc copy Level 1.
name: Mustard Row
theme: Mustard-yellow corner shops with hand-lettered signs and shutters the Rust have chained down.
intro: Shutters chained, signs faded. Zed's neighbours are watching from behind the glass. Clear the row and open a shop.
outro: Chains drop, shutters roll up, and the first hand-lettered sign goes back in the window. Mustard Row is open for business.
notes: Bosses per the-story-campaign#1 (miniBoss/mainBoss are enemy ids, not wave entries). No main boss per the-story-campaign#1. Old title "Transit District" is flavour only. Owner decision: Level 2 matches Level 1 in length (5 waves, 210 s) and build-up, but is the harder level: bigger waves (5, 7, 8, 10), Watchers, Type 2 Breakers, bigger healing breathers (25-55 vs 15-35) and a bigger finale. Owner decision: waves interleave grunts, Watchers and Type 2 Breakers (wave.mix, mixElites) and every wave moves faster than Level 1 (speedMult 1.15-1.3). Wave 5 is the mini-boss beat: "Railgun" Royce walks in from the far side with 8 Watchers (Level 1 has 4 grunts); the wave is smaller than wave 4 by design (validator exempts leader waves from the no-shrink rule). No boss phase on this level.

gddGap: No level structure in the GDD. Introduces the Rust Breaker (rust-breaker) bruiser alongside the Rust Watcher and grunts; waves vary arrival pattern (slow heavy waves, then a quick burst) rather than only raising counts.
name: Greenline Courts
theme: Forest-green basketball courts: chain-link, faded lines, a hoop with no net.
intro: Faded lines, empty hoops. Zed fights so kids can play here again. Clear the court.
outro: Somebody finds a ball. Bounce, bounce, swish. The courts are full of kids again.
notes: Bosses per the-story-campaign#1 (miniBoss/mainBoss are enemy ids, not wave entries). Calder arena flavour: factory floor (old "Industrial Zone" title, flavour only). Owner decision: the mini-boss arrives as a mini wave, a beatable pressure wave led by the mini-boss, deliberately not too hard and not a hard gate. Owner decision: the main boss gets its own separate fight phase after the waves (own arena phase, phases per the GDD). Fix (2026-11-03): wave 3 Breaker count raised from 3 to 5 so waves never shrink (validator rule); maxAlive stays 2.

miniBoss.note: beatable pressure wave led by the mini-boss

gddGap: No level structure in the GDD. Level 4 fields the GDD's Rust Specialists, "The Copper Fangs" (rust-specialist) and the Rust Rangers (rust-ranger) in alternating waves, then a mixed Ranger and grunt surge, and closes on the mini-boss Glitch (rust-glitch) as a single-enemy wave, so the player must use lane movement against ranged pressure before a deception fight. Wave 5 is the mini-boss beat: Glitch (GlitchBoss, 340 HP, overclocks at half health) walks in from the far side and four Rust Rangers join after his first move; the validator lets a leader wave be smaller than the one before it. No restPickup on the last wave (the exit follows it). 180 s limit assumed.
name: Stewpot Gardens
theme: Food stalls with striped awnings and community garden planters behind Rust fencing.
intro: Zed's mother's stall stood just past the fence. Keep moving, sidestep those darts, and bring dinner back.
outro: The fence comes down, the planters get watered, and a pot of stew goes on. Everyone gets a bowl.

gddGap: No level structure or final-level beat in the GDD (narrative review notes the premise has no ending). Waves 1-4 interleave grunts, Rust Watchers and Type 2 Breaker elites (wave.mix, mixElites); wave 5 is the Raptor mini-boss beat and the last wave. Owner decision 2026-11-03: Copper Fang, Wren and the 3-wave Breaker/Copper Fang tail were cut. Wave sizes and the 210 s limit are assumed; five levels is an assumption.
name: Songwindow Heights
theme: Tall apartment blocks, painted-over mural walls and open windows waiting for music.
intro: Every window is shut and every mural is painted over. Zed climbs the Heights so the music can drift out again.
outro: A window opens, then another. Music pours down the block and the murals start to rise. The city sings.
notes: Bosses per the-story-campaign#1 (miniBoss/mainBoss are enemy ids, not wave entries). Owner decision 2026-11-03: Level 5 has 5 waves. Waves 1-4 mix up to 3 non-boss enemy types each (grunt, rust-watcher, rust-breaker via Type 2 elites); boss-role enemies (Copper Fang, Wren) are not used in the regular waves. The old waves 5-7 (Wren, Breakers, Copper Fang surge) were removed. The last wave (wave 5) is the Raptor mini-boss beat: Raptor walks in from the far side with 8 Watchers/grunts, not a hard gate; the wave is smaller than wave 4 by design (validator exempts leader waves from the no-shrink rule). Owner decision: the mini-boss arrives as a mini wave, a beatable pressure wave led by the mini-boss. Wren arena flavour: rooftops (old "Skyline District", flavour only). OPEN: mainBoss Wren still has a separate fight phase after the waves (earlier owner decision); confirm whether that stays.
